goal: Eliminate unapproved ordinary duplication/over-extraction across current code; collect low-probability defenses for unified user review.

scope.other_current_code: tests, maintenance/build scripts and reachable vendored code remain in scope
scope.frozen_evidence: Do not rewrite historical verification/research source snapshots; classify references and preserve original bytes.

reviewed_entries.evidence: Only a package docstring; no executable validation or wrapper.
Declarative model/title/panel-type adapter consumed by GuestMechanismPanel/Dialog.

Shared-reader adapter; _technical_extra is a polymorphic extension called with a selected row or None by _topic_changed.

reviewed_entries.trigger: matches：非字典敌人/非字符串查询返回False；资料片段非字符串被忽略
reviewed_entries.impact: 坏数据静默当作不匹配，可能隐藏内部类型错误
reviewed_entries.recommendation: 核对当前读取入口契约后删除内部坏类型兜底，或保留并注明过滤范围

reviewed_entries.recommendation: 建议仅已确认的“未找到凭据”返回空，其它系统错误上报；具体系统错误码待核对
